meta.title: A saved eRFX draft: "12" opens its menu
warnings: resolved: “The case's exact meaning of the control labeled "12" is ambiguous; the catalog can open the stage overflow menu but cann” — expect_options opens the list and reads what it offers, with greyed-out items

steps.note: Create the saved eRFX draft used by the test.
Give the draft the title referenced by the case so it can be found in Drafts.
Configure the eRFX project with an RFQ stage.
Move to the RFQ stage before configuring its template and sheet.
Apply the RFQ template required before adding line items.
Add the minimum line item needed for a valid saved draft.
Complete the pricing sheet before saving the draft.
Commit a schedule so the draft follows the normal saved eRFX path.
Add the minimum participant required for the draft setup.
Create the saved, unpublished eRFX draft required by the scenario.
Verify the draft save completed without an application error.
Navigate to the Events list as the buyer would.
Open the Drafts tab specified by the case.
Assert that the saved draft titled 12 appears in Drafts.
Open the matching saved draft from the Drafts list.
Open the RFQ stage's overflow menu, the catalog-supported interpretation of the draft control whose menu is being explored.
Assert the menu opens and contains the known draft stage-menu controls.
